actor_report:
OBSERVATIONS (supplied workspace snapshot only): The exact name APP_TOKEN has three consumers besides deploy/env.example. src/settings.py reads it with os.environ['APP_TOKEN'], which is a hard KeyError if it is absent. scripts/check_env.sh requires it via ${APP_TOKEN:?missing}. docs/config.md documents it. APP_TOKEN_TTL is a separate variable that shares the prefix. The task names only APP_TOKEN, so APP_TOKEN_TTL is deliberately left unchanged in all four files. A blind substring replace would have renamed it too, which would be an unrequested Public change outside the grant.

WORK: I propose a full-file replacement for each of the four files. Each one renames only the exact token APP_TOKEN to APP_API_TOKEN, with no other byte changes. Public delta: the identity APP_TOKEN is removed and APP_API_TOKEN is added. A rename is removal plus addition, per Computed Classification And Treatment item 2. Members retained unchanged: APP_TOKEN_TTL with default 3600, and LOG_LEVEL.

SCOPE OF EVIDENCE: My evaluation is static inspection of the supplied snapshot and my proposed contents. I ran nothing and applied nothing. The host applies the edits and runs any assertions.

UNRESOLVED:
(1) External dependents. Deployed environments, CI or secret stores, container or orchestration manifests, and any files outside this projection may still set APP_TOKEN. Absence from a partial projection is not evidence of absence (FOUNDATIONS Workspace and context). Any such environment will fail at src/settings.py import time and in check_env.sh until it sets APP_API_TOKEN.
(2) Transitional fallback. One option is to read APP_API_TOKEN and fall back to APP_TOKEN, which would keep old deployments working. I did not add it. It creates a second accepted name, a competing truth path, and that is a contract choice for the owner rather than part of a plain rename. If the owner wants it, the minimal change is a single line in src/settings.py: TOKEN = os.environ.get('APP_API_TOKEN') or os.environ['APP_TOKEN']. check_env.sh would need a matching change.
(3) Runtime proof. Importing settings and running check_env.sh with only APP_API_TOKEN set was not performed.
(4) Acceptance. Accepting these edits is reserved to the existing decision authority, not to me (SPEC_METHOD UP-020 Proportional Disposition; TICKET_METHOD UP-007).
